training.supplementary_checkpoint: minimum validation loss, earliest epoch on exact tie

assumptions_not_disclosed_by_authors: training margin m=0.1 and tolerance n=0.01 (retained from the already predeclared earlier experiment, not fitted to this test)
no scheduler, warmup or gradient clipping
validation seed42 and ceil rounding to 105 rows
FP32 and activation checkpointing for V100 memory
dynamic padding and 4096 cap to preserve all original text

evaluation.primary_f1: weighted, supported by independently audited baseline rows; paper does not explicitly name averaging
evaluation.primary_correlation: global score difference versus human relative label, scipy tau-b and spearman
evaluation.supplementary_correlation: global three-class predictions versus human label; also tau-c for definition audit

runtime.software_choice_basis: Matches released checkpoint save metadata; original full training environment is not disclosed
